question: Which products have never been ordered?
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items) ORDER BY name;

question: Show the average price of Electronics products.
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics';

question: Show the count of products in each price tier (cheap/mid/expensive).
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN price < 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cheap, SUM(CASE WHEN price BETWEEN 30 AND 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mid, SUM(CASE WHEN price > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expensive FROM products;

question: Count orders by status for the year 2023.
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2023%' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

question: How many customers are in each city?
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC;

question: Show customer name and total number of orders for customers from the UK.
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'UK' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY n_orders DESC;

question: Show the total amount spent by each customer.
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Find the average stock quantity across all products.
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(stock_qty), 1) AS avg_stock FROM products;

question: Find orders placed by customers from Italy.

question: List customers who ordered Electronics products.
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name, c.city FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY c.name;

question: Show total sales (revenue) per product, top 10.
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)

question: How many orders were placed in each quarter of 2023?
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-03-31' THEN 'Q1'      WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-06-30' THEN 'Q2'      WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-09-30' THEN 'Q3'      ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2023%' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter;

question: Label each product as 'cheap' (<$30), 'mid' ($30-$100), or 'expensive' (>$100).
